reels.title: SoL-Refiner: Speed-of-Light One-Step Refinement for High-Resolution Video

editorial_notes.reasoning: This falls under 'multimodal_diffusion' (1.68x multiplier), which is our highest-performing category. It solves a relatable problem: how to make high-res video generation instant without the typical heavy compute cost.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could turn a blurry, low-res video into a crystal-clear masterpiece in a single blink?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A professional digital artist who makes a rough sketch in seconds, then instantly applies a filter that fills in all the intricate textures and details.
